mapper.select: select board_idx, board_conidx, board_name, date_format(board_regdate, '%Y-%m-%d') as board_regdate from tcc_board where board_config='A' order by board_conidx desc limit #{snum}, 10
select ceil(count(board_conidx)/10) pages from tcc_board where board_config='A' and ${fkey} like #{fval}
select board_idx, board_conidx, board_name, board_regdate from tcc_board where board_config='B' order by board_conidx desc limit #{snum}, 10
select ceil(count(board_conidx)/10) pages from tcc_board where board_config='B' and ${fkey} like #{fval}
mapper.update: update tcc_board set board_readcount = board_readcount + 1 where board_idx = #{board_idx}
mapper.select: select board_idx , board_config , board_conidx , board_name , board_contents , board_attachName , board_attachPath , date_format(board_regdate, '%Y-%m-%d') as board_regdate , board_readcount , mem_idx from tcc_board where board_idx = #{board_idx}
mapper.insert: insert into tcc_qna (qna_memidx, qna_name, qna_contents, qna_attachName, qna_attachPath, mem_idx) values (#{qna_memidx}, #{qna_name}, #{qna_contents}, #{qna_attachName}, #{qna_attachPath}, #{mem_idx})
mapper.select: select * from tcc_qna where mem_idx=#{mem_idx} order by qna_memidx desc limit #{snum}, 10
select ceil(count(qna_memidx)/10) pages from tcc_qna where mem_idx=#{mem_idx}
select max(qna_memidx) from tcc_qna where mem_idx=#{mem_idx}

select tc.comment_idx, tc.comment_content, tc.board_idx, tc.mem_idx, (select mem_aka from tcc_member tm where tm.mem_idx = tc.mem_idx ) as mem_name, date_format(tc.comment_regdate, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as comment_regdate from tcc_comment tc where tc.board_idx = #{board_idx} order by tc.comment_regdate desc
